text: Another pattern I found that agents completely forget to implement is optimistic updates.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So rather than showing your users a bunch of loading spinner whenever they're taking any action, you essentially show them the success state, you know, optimistically, and in the background, you're going to sync whatever change they made.

text: Now, if the sync or the operation fails for whatever reason, you just roll it back and then tell them like, oh, the operation didn't work.
